description: trusted_issuer_store.rs explicitly uses ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::verify_strict instead of the standard verify(). verify_strict rejects small-order points, non-canonical scalar values, and other malleability vectors. The decision comment (DECISION rbe3.83) explains why x509-parser's built-in verification is not used. This is the correct choice for an authentication-critical signature check.
title: good: trusted_issuer uses ed25519-dalek verify_strict to reject non-canonical signatures
